VBO:0200796.summary: Still a handful at twelve months, La-Chon Josh offers a personal glimpse of this Lhasa Apso–Bichon Frise cross. His owner recalls that he learned to sit, offer a paw and lie down by four months, with food helping simple lessons. At seven months, he entered a willful stage: when other dogs were around, he wanted to play and ignored recall even when a treat was offered.
VBO:0200796.shortDescription: A Lhasa Apso–Bichon cross; Josh’s early story pairs food-motivated learning with a willful, play-distracted recall stage.
